  • Classes in com.eqixiac.equinix.iam.model used by com.eqixiac.equinix.iam.client
    Class
    Description
    AccessPolicy
    A project-scoped IAM access policy — a set of permissions that may be granted to principals, groups or other projects.
    AccessPolicyGrant
    A grant associating a grantee (a principal, group or project) with an IAM access policy, as returned by the grant operations (GET .../accessPolicies/{accessPolicyId}/grants, operationId listGrants; POST .../grants, operationId addGrant).
    EffectivePermissions
    The effective (resolved) permissions for a principal within a project and service, as returned by the IAM effective-permissions operation.
    PermissionSet
    A named, reusable set of permissions within a project, as returned by the IAM permission set operations (listPermissionSets, createPermissionSet, getPermissionSet, updatePermissionSet).
    PolicyMask
    A policy mask that constrains the managed policies and permission sets available to a principal, as returned by the IAM policy-mask operations.
    PrincipalPolicy
    An access policy attached directly to a principal (user), as returned by the IAM principal-policy operations.
    RoleAssignment
    An assignment of a Role to a principal within a scope, as returned by the IAM role assignment operations (GET /v1/roleAssignments, operationId listRoleAssignments; POST /v1/roleAssignments, operationId createRoleAssignment; GET /v1/roleAssignments/{roleAssignmentId}, operationId getRoleAssignment).
    ServicePolicySchema
    The policy schema for a service, describing the structure of policies the service accepts, as returned by the IAM service-policy-schema operation.

  • Classes in com.eqixiac.equinix.iam.model used by com.eqixiac.equinix.iam.model
    Class
    Description
    Attribute
    An attribute included on a resource type or action, as returned by the IAM resource-type and list-actions operations.
    EffectivePermissions.Permission
    A single effective-permission entry: the caller may perform any of the EffectivePermissions.Permission.getActions() on the referenced resources (or any except those referenced), optionally gated by a Cedar EffectivePermissions.Permission.getCondition() expression.
    EffectivePermissions.ResourceSelector
    An anyOf selector that is either an inclusion set (the listed values) or an exclusion set ({except: [...]}).
    ListedAction.PermissionCode
     
    ListedAction.RbacPermission
    The action mapping to access-management permissions, used when performing authorization via role-assignment token scope (spec schema RBACPermission).
    PolicyExpression
    A lossless, typed wrapper for the polymorphic oneOf union members used throughout the IAM access-control schemas — the permissions/intersect/subtract entries of an AccessPolicy, PermissionSet and PrincipalPolicy, and the managedPolicies/managedPermissionSets/subtract fields of a PolicyMask.
    Role.Permission
     
    RoleAssignment.AssignmentScope
     
    RoleAssignment.Parent

    The action mapping to access-management permissions, used when performing authorization via role-assignment token scope (spec schema RBACPermission).

    A registered resource type within the IAM access model, as returned by the IAM resource-type operations.

    The association between an action and a resource type, as returned by the IAM resource-type-action operations.

    A named set of role actions that can be granted to a principal, as returned by the IAM roles catalog (GET /v1/roles, operationId listRoles; and GET /v1/projects/{projectId}/roles, operationId listRolesByProjectId).
